headlines.title: NASA administrator explains how Roman Telescope will change understanding of the universe
headlines.description: NBC News' Gadi Schwartz speaks with NASA administrator Jared Isaacman about the Nancy Grace Roman Telescope launch, the Artemis III launch in 2027, and SpaceX's new Louisiana Starbase.

headlines.title: Fears of more flooding in Nepal, 100 Americans among the missing as rescue efforts step up
headlines.description: KATHMANDU — Authorities in Nepal have warned of the risk of further flooding after heavy rainfall, as China sheds light on the scale of the disaster in its Tibet region.

headlines.title: Minnesota Supreme Court rejects Mike Lindell’s bid to recount GOP primary
headlines.description: MyPillow founder Mike Lindell has long denied Donald Trump’s loss in the 2020 presidential election.

headlines.title: Iran’s supreme leader urges Gulf rulers to confront ‘real enemy’ in written message
headlines.description: Iran’s Supreme Leader ​Mojtaba Khamenei urged Muslim countries, particularly those in the Gulf, to unite against what he called their “real enemy” and said divisions among Muslims served the interests of their adversaries.

headlines.title: Milo Yiannopoulos deported to the U.K. one day after ICE arrest
headlines.description: Milo Yiannopoulos, a controversy-baiting internet personality who once vehemently backed President Donald Trump, has been deported to the United Kingdom, a Department of Homeland Security spokesperson said on Saturday.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Water cuts are coming for Arizona. Is your salad on the chopping block?
headlines.description: Yuma County, Arizona grows 90% of the U.S.’ winter salad greens. But the state relies on the depleted Colorado River, and water cuts are about to hit.

headlines.title: Four baby goats at mobile petting zoo in North Carolina test positive for rabies
headlines.description: Four baby goats from a North Carolina mobile petting zoo tested positive for rabies and were euthanized, and health officials are asking anyone who may have had contact with them to reach out for possible treatment.

headlines.title: Taylor Swift donates $50,000 to mother who was seriously injured in car accident
headlines.description: Taylor Swift has donated $50,000 to help a Rhode Island mother who was left seriously injured in a car accident last month, NBC News has confirmed.
